docs.note: Public Data Help page: import instructions, data definitions FAQ, codebook and GIS help.

api.note: No API or web-service page; public data is offered as downloadable text files and shapefiles plus a search website.

pricing.note: No fee schedule or statement that downloads are free on the public data pages; custom requests are quoted by open records request.

changelog.note: No release notes; the downloads page shows a Last Updated date and the public data page a yearly update timeline. Browser-rendered page read through the built-in browser.

items.excerpt: Data includes property information like owner name, mailing address and legal descriptions, neighborhood information, permit information and deed information.
Residential building information, information of income producing properties including occupancy rates and operating income
items.note: Building Information download; nothing on sale prices in the listing.

items.excerpt: HCAD's data files are available to users for import into other applications.
Download times can be excessive and should not be attempted with a slower internet connection.
items.note: Files are county-wide, very large ASCII tab-delimited text.

items.excerpt: Consists of current year GIS format files including the prior year shapefiles.
GIS data updates on this webpage quarterly.
The public data provided is raw data or text files and will need to be formatted for use in a database.
An estimate of the cost with a breakdown will be sent requiring approval prior to any work is performed.
items.note: For custom data requests; HCAD gives no technical support for the files.

items.excerpt: The search limit on any given search is 3001 records
Current Year Real and Personal Property Records on the internet server are usually updated from the District's system on a nightly basis.
The HCAD address search does NOT work like online address search engines
items.note: Address matching is literal; owner searches accept partial names.
